book: Book B, create-reverse-split-lot-test-data (:124-184): AAPL (NASDAQ, SCU 1). 2020-01-01 "Buy AAPL lot": AAPL +100 for $5,000 against Cash -$5,000. 2020-02-01 "Reverse Split": AAPL -50, value 0, split-type "stock-split", action "Split". Both AAPL splits are in one untitled lot; no prices. AAPL holds 50 shares. GnuCash's engine gives the lot a balance of 0 and calls it closed: gnc_lot_get_balance sums adjusted amounts, and the reverse split scales the buy's to 50 while keeping its own -50 (5.17:libgnucash/engine/Account.cpp:2285-2308, gnc-lot.cpp:505-511). Investment Lots reads raw amounts and never the engine's balance.
dates: No date in the book depends on now. Every run keeps the default Start date and End date, start-accounting-period and today (5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/investment-lots.scm:353-359); with no preferences both are today, taken at the end of the day (:667-672): 2024-03-15 23:59:59 UTC for the pinned now. Both splits fall before the window, as in GnuCash's own run on any date after 2020.
optionValues: Every run uses the template's default options.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109) after stripping <script> elements (:40-42). Row 0 selects every <th> text of table 1, in document order: the test's header list (:737). "columnOfHeader": L stands for (sxml->table-row-col sxml 1 #f N), the texts of the Nth <td> of every row, where N is the 1-based position of the first text equal to L in the header list (find-col-index, :371-376); when no text equals L the test uses the empty list (:745-747, :770-775).
checkShapes: "contains": the selected texts include this string. "noneEqual": no selected text equals it. "noneContain": no selected text contains it. "always": the assertion is the constant #t. "equalTo": the selected texts equal, as lists, those the same selection gives for the named run of another fixture.
